//: [fix4-stop2] STOP key v4 (stop4.py): one designed control - red cap (crisp R1.2 roll, 2.0 side, 0.6 dish, rear-reading legend) over a dark shroud in a flush dark socket ringed by a flush opal status ring; true tip gap; spring tolerances; closed-box links + y-float stem lug + POM bush; lid-closed magnet / hall pair; return springs on the lower pin under a pivot cover.

lid.//well_weep: S7: two TPE duckbills (hole d 3, 1.2 from the frame edges, |y| > 30) at the front corners of the well floor frame: water past the boot + lip seal leaves the sealed well into the body cavity (deck drains); the gutter is ~14 mm above the well floor, so it cannot take it

stop_key.//v4: stopkit.build -> stop4.build (design_gen); false = the f3 key
stop_key.//stroke: S1-B: 5.5 to the shroud's castellated rim on the socket
stop_key.//clear: S2: skirt 2.0 over the lid plane = 1.7 over the dark socket at full stroke (1.0 grit + the 0.53 deg edge-press roll at r 20 = 1.52 still clear: stopcheck grit_case)
stop_key.//gap: S1: TRUE gap = minimum vertical distance tip surface -> scanned key surface (stop4.true_gap_tip), asserted by stopcheck
stop_key.//cap: A5: crisp R1.2 roll, 2.0 straight side, 0.6 concave dish (finger seat); flat face d 37.6 (S5)
stop_key.//legend_front: A7: the STOP inlay reads from BEHIND, like the display and the real key on the fixed panel (one product reading direction)
stop_key.//tip_h: S6: TPE tip 1.5 tall (0.8 land + 0.7 dome): stem bottom -> tip top 6.6 >= the worst-case compliance travel 5.9 + 0.5 (stopcheck stem_tip_room)
stop_key.//bush: S6 / M4: rod guide in the stem bottom 2.2 long, rod head 0.8: the compliance-spring chamber grows 0.5 so the spring (solid + 0.6) still has travel for the worst-case compliance travel 5.9 (stopcheck stem_tip_room.spring_block_margin)
stop_key.//stem_above_key: S6: rigid stem 9.5 over the key top (stopcheck: >= 0.5 in the worst stack at full stroke + lid over-travel)
stop_key.//arm: S2 / S4: closed stainless boxes 12.2 x 2.8 x 0.4, open tines only round the stem lug / bracket; 4.0 apart (lower link clears the key in the worst stack)
stop_key.//F_c0: M4: compliance spring grade 1, 100 % force-sorted: 15.2 N > 15 N key maximum, so the plunger never yields before the key switches
stop_key.//F_ret: M4: return springs 2.0 +- 0.2 N, 0.15 N/mm +- 10 %; friction 0..1.0 N incl. the stem lip seal
stop_key.//tip_comp: M4: TPE tip compression before the key moves

colors.//stop: A6: RAL 3020 traffic red (sRGB #C1121C): CIE x 0.615 y 0.325, luminance factor 0.12, inside the ISO 3864-4 safety-red box (stopcheck colour.iso3864_4); the f3 #C8102E (Pantone 186C crimson, x 0.596 y 0.313) lies just outside it on the purple side and renders pink / coral. Lid key, real key and stand-in
colors.//stop_finish: A6: fine moulded-in texture (the dark core's finish, no clear coat): measured in the studio renders it reads the same deep red from every side (plan 191,65,60 / 3-4 view 190,67,62 / closed-lid view 190,69,64 with matte; gloss and satin-coat wash out to 194,137,136 / 193,117,115 in plan under the soft box); a textured key also keeps its grip wet (renderer colors.stop_finish)
colors.//halo_emit: A1: the opal ring reads as a lit status light in the product renders
